_comment: Made-up course for tests. The syllabus quoted here does not exist.
name: CSCE 423

guidance.rule: You may use AI to explain a concept from lecture, but not to solve a homework problem.
guidance.quote: Generative AI tools may be used to help you understand course concepts. They may not be used to produce solutions, proofs, or code for graded homework.

guidance.rule: Any AI use on a homework must be disclosed at the top of the submission.
guidance.quote: If you used an AI tool in any way while working on an assignment, say so at the top of your submission, naming the tool and what you used it for.

guidance.rule: No AI of any kind during exams.
guidance.quote: Exams are closed-book and closed-device. No AI tools.
